items.text: Lamar Jackson (BAL) was limited Wednesday, his first practice since the Week 4 ankle sprain, and Jesse Minter called it a day-by-day thing. Tyler Huntley starts vs CIN if he sits. Lamar is QB21 for me this week, a streamer until he practices in full, and QB2 rest of season. Monitor Baltimore's Friday injury report.

Baker Mayfield (TB) practiced in full Wednesday for the first time since dislocating his right thumb in Week 3, and Todd Bowles will decide Friday whether he or Jalon Daniels starts at CAR. Mayfield is outside my top 12 this week and QB24 rest of season for me. Monitor Todd Bowles' Friday decision.
Bucky Irving (TB) missed practice Wednesday with an illness. He is RB13 for me this week at CAR, borderline RB1/RB2. Monitor Tampa Bay's Thursday practice report.

Emeka Egbuka (TB) did not practice Wednesday with a concussion and a foot injury. He is WR27 for me this week, a high-end WR3, only if he clears the protocol. Monitor his concussion status on Friday's injury report.
items.watch: his concussion status on Friday's injury report

items.text: Chicago ruled out Kyle Monangai (CHI) for Thursday vs NE with the thumb and toe after he missed every walkthrough this week, his third straight game out. D'Andre Swift leads the backfield again and is RB10 for me this week. Monangai is RB29 rest of season for me; hold him, and a missed practice next week makes him a drop.
items.why: A missed practice next week, after a third straight game out, makes him a drop.

items.text: Jordan Mason (MIN) practiced in full Wednesday as his IR window opened with the thumb. Once Minnesota activates him he takes the early downs vs IND, RB29 for me this week, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play. Aaron Jones Sr. is RB16 for me, an RB2. Monitor Mason's activation off IR by Saturday.

items.text: Justin Jefferson (MIN) was limited Wednesday with the ankle, a maintenance day. He is WR11 for me this week vs IND, borderline WR1/WR2. Monitor Minnesota's Friday injury report.

John Harbaugh named J.J. McCarthy (NYG) the starter at HOU over Jameis Winston. McCarthy threw for 243 yards, a TD and an interception in relief vs NO, most of it after the Giants fell behind 34-10. He is outside my top 12 this week. Monitor his first start at Houston Sunday before you add him in superflex leagues.

items.text: David Montgomery (HOU) missed practice Wednesday with the groin, still week to week with Houston's bye in Week 8. Woody Marks played 78 percent of the snaps in Week 6 and is RB20 for me vs NYG, an RB2. Montgomery is RB21 rest of season for me. Monitor Houston's Friday injury report.

Breece Hall (NYJ) missed practice again Wednesday with the quad, and Aaron Glenn would not rule him out vs MIA but said Braelon Allen keeps getting touches. Allen is RB12 for me this week, borderline RB1/RB2. Hall is RB16 rest of season for me. Monitor New York's Friday injury report.

Rashee Rice (KC) did not practice Wednesday with the hamstring, though Andy Reid said he is making progress; he also missed practice last Wednesday and Thursday. WR20 rest of season for me. Monitor Kansas City's Thursday practice report before Sunday at SEA.

Tyler Warren (IND) did not practice Wednesday with the groin that kept him out vs TEN in Week 6, when Keenan Allen drew 11 targets. Warren is outside my top 12 this week until he practices and TE3 rest of season for me. Monitor Indianapolis' Friday injury report.

Mike Evans (SF) did not practice Wednesday with the Achilles tendinitis and is expected to miss Sunday at ATL, with San Francisco's bye after it, so Week 9 is the earliest return. WR26 rest of season for me. Hold him on your bench; a missed practice after the bye makes him a sell.
items.why: Week 9 is the earliest return; a missed practice after the bye makes him a sell.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins (CLE) was limited Wednesday with the ankle after missing Week 6, and Todd Monken is optimistic he plays at TEN. He is RB20 rest of season for me and outside my top 40 backs this week until he practices in full. Monitor Cleveland's Friday injury report.
Jordan Love (GB) was limited Wednesday with the back. He is QB3 for me this week at DET. Monitor Green Bay's Friday injury report.

Kyle Shanahan said Christian Kirk (SF) is a possibility for Sunday at ATL after two good practices with the calf, and Mike Evans (Achilles) looks unlikely to play. Kirk is still on IR and has not played a snap this season, so he would step into a receiver room missing its top target. Add him in 12-team leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

items.why: No practice window opening after the Week 8 bye makes him a drop.
items.text: Saints GM Mickey Loomis said Jordyn Tyson (NO) won't practice this week with the hamstring but is getting closer. New Orleans plays PIT in Paris Sunday and then has its Week 8 bye, so Tyson has at least two more weeks on IR. WR55 rest of season for me. Hold him in an IR spot; no practice window after the bye makes him a drop.

Tuesday's MRI showed a torn patellar tendon in the left knee of Terry McLaurin (WAS), and Dan Quinn said he needs surgery and misses the rest of the season. Stefon Diggs is the top receiver when Washington returns in Week 8, WR30 rest of season for me. Drop McLaurin for any add; hold Diggs.

items.why: A second straight game with Corey Kiner taking the late carries makes him a sell.
items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (NE) practiced in full Monday and Tuesday on the ankle before Thursday at CHI, but Corey Kiner closed out the Jets after Henderson's fumble. RB26 rest of season for me. Hold Henderson; a second straight game with Kiner taking the late carries makes him a sell.

items.why: Missing Wednesday's practice before the Thursday game changes it.
items.text: A.J. Brown (NE) was limited Monday and Tuesday with the ankle but is not expected to miss Thursday at CHI. He ran a route on 97 percent of the dropbacks and drew 10 targets vs NYJ, and Romeo Doubs is on IR. WR24 rest of season for me; hold him through the drops.

Kyle Monangai (CHI) missed practice again Tuesday with the thumb and toe and is very unlikely to play Thursday vs NE, a third straight game out. RB29 rest of season for me. Monitor Chicago's Wednesday practice report. D'Andre Swift leads the backfield again, RB13 rest of season for me; hold him.

items.text: Houston plans to activate Tank Dell (HOU) off IR for Week 7 vs NYG, his first game since the 2024 knee injury. He plays the slot, so Jaylin Noel and the depth receivers lose snaps first. Monitor his route share vs NYG Sunday before you add him.

Jaylin Noel (HOU) caught 4 for 107 and a TD on 4 targets at JAX on 63 percent of the routes, but Tank Dell returns to share the slot vs NYG. Add him in deep leagues, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB and no more.
Matt LaFleur would not commit to Josh Jacobs (GB) playing Week 7 at DET, though Jacobs is off the exempt list and eligible. RB37 rest of season for me. Monitor Green Bay's Wednesday practice report.
MarShawn Lloyd (GB) ran 8 times for 10 and played 30 snaps vs DAL, 11 fewer than the back ahead of him, and Josh Jacobs is eligible again. RB41 rest of season for me; drop him for any add.

Mike Macdonald said there is a good chance Zach Charbonnet (SEA) plays Week 7 vs KC. The fill-ins split 46 and 27 snaps Sunday, so the early downs are his when he is back. RB47 rest of season for me. Monitor Seattle's Wednesday practice report.

items.watch: his activation off IR before Sunday vs IND
items.text: Minnesota designated Jordan Mason (MIN) to return from IR, opening his practice window before Week 7 vs IND, and he takes early downs once active. RB35 rest of season for me. Monitor his activation before Sunday; hold Aaron Jones Sr. until then.
Jesse Minter called Lamar Jackson (BAL) day to day with the ankle and said he could practice this week. QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor Baltimore's Wednesday practice report.

The Giants released Najee Harris (NYG) on Tuesday, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Jordan Raanan, after 31 carries for 99 yards in five games, 3.2 a carry, and 4 for 2 vs NO. Drop him in every format.

With Najee Harris gone, the Giants are down to three backs at Houston: Devin Singletary played 40 percent of the snaps vs NO, Tyrone Tracy Jr. (NYG) 38 percent with two TDs on 8 touches, and Cam Skattebo 6 snaps. Add Tracy, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB; he is the bench piece if John Harbaugh leans on him.

Mike Evans (SF) has Achilles tendinitis that flared up Monday night, and Kyle Shanahan said it is not a long-term problem. NBC Sports Bay Area reports the Achilles is intact but San Francisco is bracing for him to miss at ATL, with the bye in Week 8. He is WR26 rest of season for me. Monitor; San Francisco's Wednesday practice report.

Baker Mayfield (TB) is set to practice Wednesday on the dislocated right thumb, but Fox Sports' Greg Auman reports Todd Bowles is still planning for Jalon Daniels to make a fourth straight start at CAR. Mayfield is QB24 rest of season for me. Monitor; Tampa Bay's Wednesday practice report.

Jeremiyah Love (ARI) was expected to do some running Tuesday on the ankle, per Mike LaFleur, after missing Week 6 at LAR, where Bam Knight ran 15 times for 80. Love is RB15 rest of season for me. Monitor; Arizona's Wednesday practice report before at DEN.
